skill.name: planner
skill.description: Create phased software implementation plans with sprints, atomic tasks, validation steps, and risk checks.
skill.summary: Turn software requests into structured plans with sprints, tasks, validation, and gotchas.
skill.author: am-will

content.user_title: Plan Software Work in Phased Sprints
content.value_statement: Implementation work can fail when requirements, risks, and validation steps are unclear. Planner turns a request into phased sprints, atomic tasks, validation checks, and gotchas.
actual_capabilities: Researches codebase structure, related components, dependencies, and existing implementation patterns.
Clarifies goals, scope, users, constraints, data needs, permissions, performance, and testing requirements.
Uses Context7 documentation when a plan involves an external library, API, framework, or service.
Builds phased plans with overview, prerequisites, sprints, atomic tasks, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
Adds demo and validation checklists for each sprint so progress can be tested incrementally.
Saves the plan as a kebab-case Markdown file with a -plan.md suffix.
limitations: It creates plans only and does not implement code changes.
Plan quality depends on available repository context and user answers.
External documentation lookup depends on Context7 availability.
Complexity estimates are planning guidance and may change during implementation.

use_cases.title: Plan a Feature Build
use_cases.description: Break a feature request into sprints, files, tasks, acceptance criteria, and validation steps.

use_cases.title: Prepare Team Execution
use_cases.description: Create a shared implementation plan with dependencies, demo checkpoints, and testing strategy.

use_cases.title: Scope a Bug Fix
use_cases.description: Turn an unclear defect report into questions, investigation steps, risks, and committable repair tasks.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Implementation Plan

prompt_templates.title: Bug Fix Plan

prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate debugging plan with testing needs.

prompt_templates.title: Library Integration Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use planner to design a plan for integrating Stripe subscriptions. Use current official docs before drafting tasks.

prompt_templates.title: Cross-Team Migration Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use planner to create a multi-sprint migration plan for replacing the auth system. Include risks, dependencies, and demo checkpoints.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning for a broad technical change.

output_examples.input: Plan the implementation for Google OAuth login.
output_examples.output: A Markdown plan with an overview, prerequisites, sprints, atomic tasks, acceptance criteria, validation steps, risks, and rollback notes.

output_examples.input: Break down a bug fix for slow dashboard loading.
output_examples.output: A phased investigation and repair plan covering profiling, query review, frontend checks, test updates, and demo validation.

output_examples.input: Create a plan for migrating from local files to S3 storage.
output_examples.output: A multi-sprint migration plan with documentation research, configuration tasks, data movement, validation, edge cases, and rollback guidance.

best_practices: Provide the goal, affected users, constraints, and expected success criteria before planning.
Answer clarification questions before asking for the final plan.
Review the generated gotchas and update the plan before implementation starts.
anti_patterns: Do not use it when you want the agent to implement changes immediately.
Do not skip clarification when requirements, dependencies, or risks are unclear.
Do not treat estimates or task order as fixed after new technical facts appear.

faq.question: Does this skill write code?
faq.answer: No. It creates implementation plans and explicitly avoids making code changes.

faq.question: What kind of plans does it create?
faq.answer: It creates phased Markdown plans with sprints, atomic tasks, validation checks, risks, and rollback notes.

faq.question: Can it plan work for external APIs?
faq.answer: Yes. It instructs the agent to use Context7 for current official documentation when external dependencies are involved.

faq.question: Does it ask clarifying questions?
faq.answer: Yes. It asks questions about goals, scope, users, constraints, data, permissions, performance, testing, and other risks.

faq.question: Where does it save the plan?
faq.answer: It saves a Markdown file using request keywords in kebab-case with a -plan.md suffix.

faq.question: Is it useful for bug fixes?
faq.answer: Yes. It can plan investigation, repair tasks, validation steps, and rollback guidance for bug fixes.
